claim_scope.primary_claim: EAGC is noninferior to Newell for post-cutoff minimum SYM-H on a strictly prospective ICME cohort
forbidden_inferences: No ICME result may be transferred to SIR.
PASS-SUPERIOR may not be reported unless every preregistered superiority condition passes on this new cohort.

freeze.rule: The immutable anchor is the first Git commit that contains this protocol_id and protocol_version at this path.
freeze.prospective_boundary: Both icme_start_time and the catalog snapshot retrieval time MUST be strictly later than the introducing commit timestamp.
freeze.amendment_policy: Any change to cohort, cutoff, model, comparison, endpoint, or decision criteria requires a new protocol version and a new prospective cohort beginning after that version's introducing commit.

cohort.selection_rule: Take the first 20 eligible rows in the first post-freeze HELIO4CAST ICMECAT snapshots; once selected, an event cannot be replaced.

eligibility.overlap_policy: No event window may overlap another selected event window. For a deterministic overlap, retain the earlier row under cohort.ordering and skip the later row.

cohort.manifest_freeze_rule: The target-blind event manifest must be committed before any target source is queried. Scoring must refuse an uncommitted or subsequently edited manifest.

selector.name: HELIO4CAST ICMECAT
selector.version_policy: At each accrual check, use the highest officially linked ICMECAT version greater than or equal to 2.3; record the exact versioned URL and hashes. Never combine rows from unofficial mirrors.

predictors_and_target.name: NASA OMNI high-resolution 1-minute data
predictors_and_target.access_boundary: Do not query this source for selected event windows until the complete target-blind cohort manifest is frozen in an earlier commit.

model.name: EAGC
model.training_cohort: All 80 previously disclosed Richardson-Cane development events only
model.fit_policy: Fit preprocessing and coefficients once on the 80-event development cohort. Confirmatory target values must never affect fitting, feature selection, alpha, imputation, or calibration.

comparison.primary_metric: event-level RMSE of predicted versus observed minimum SYM-H

PASS-NONINFERIOR: Point relative RMSE improvement versus Newell is greater than -0.05.
Paired-bootstrap probability that relative improvement is greater than -0.05 is at least 0.90.
Every leave-one-event-out relative improvement is greater than -0.05.
PASS-SUPERIOR: Point relative RMSE improvement versus Newell is at least 0.05.
Paired-bootstrap probability that relative improvement is greater than 0 is at least 0.90.
Every leave-one-event-out relative improvement is greater than 0.
decision.REJECT: All 20 frozen events are SCORABLE and at least one PASS-NONINFERIOR condition fails.
decision.HOLD: The target-blind manifest is not frozen, fewer than 20 events have accrued, any event is not SCORABLE, provenance is incomplete, or an invariant is violated.

data_quality.failure_policy: Fail closed to HOLD; never replace an accrued event.

required_artifacts: target-blind event manifest with snapshot hashes and freeze commit
per-event predictions for EAGC and every baseline
gate metrics and paired bootstrap samples summary
claim adjudication with protocol version and scorer commit
reproducibility.determinism: All ordering and tie breaks are explicit; bootstrap seed and replicate count are fixed.
reproducibility.runner_guard: The scorer must verify that the manifest commit predates target retrieval and that protocol/model hashes match before reading target values.
